title: Allow Slideshow mode to skip dynamic wallpapers that lack the active light/dark counterpart during time-of-day switching
line: Slideshow wallpapers have a new "Only show dynamic wallpapers" option that skips wallpapers without both a light and a dark version, so a dark image no longer shows up during the day.
explanation: In a slideshow, only wallpaper packages with both images/ and images_dark/ can follow "Switch dynamic wallpapers"; plain images and single-variant packages are shown unchanged whatever the time of day or colour scheme, so a dark-only wallpaper could appear in daytime and a light one at night. Plasma has no way to tell whether a single image is meant to be light or dark. The change adds a slideshow option, "Only show dynamic wallpapers" (with a help tooltip), under the "Switch dynamic wallpapers" combobox: when on, the slide filter model skips slides that lack the day-night selector (in day-night mode) or the dark-light selector (other modes), both in the running slideshow and in the settings' image grid.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: add slideshow option to show only dynamic wallpapers

A slideshow mixing dynamic and single-image wallpapers showed the single
ones at any time of day, so a dark image could appear in daytime. Add an
option that makes the slideshow skip wallpapers without both variants.

BUG: 528401

media.caption: Master, slideshow of Next and Flow (both dynamic) plus DarkestHour (dark only) and Altai (light only), day-night mode, at night, one shot every 8 s: the light Altai and dark-only DarkestHour come up among the night variants
Same folder with "Only show dynamic wallpapers" on: only Next and Flow rotate, each in its night variant
Master settings: no way to leave out wallpapers without both variants (Altai and DarkestHour listed)
New "Only show dynamic wallpapers" checkbox under "Switch dynamic wallpapers" (slideshow only); the image grid lists only Flow and Next while it's on

review.text: Solid, well-scoped implementation of the wishlist request in plasma-workspace's image/slideshow wallpaper plugin. Adding an opt-in "Only show dynamic wallpapers" checkbox with ContextualHelpButton and SettingHighlighter avoids silently shrinking existing mixed slideshows, both image and slideshow kcfg schemas are updated, and SlideFilterModel filters using the same day-night/dark-light selectors as makeWallpaperUrl() via idiomatic bindable properties. Before/after screenshots clearly verify both runtime rotation and settings grid filtering.
